You are a Python tutor. Correct an invalid structural-rubric attempt. Respond exclusively with valid JSON containing only blocks. Return every received block in the same order, preserving id, mermaidNodeId, label and kind exactly. Correct the rubrics to match the reference code and fully satisfy the contract. The received validation error is mandatory: remove or replace the invalid reference; never invent Bind or Ref. Each Bind used by a Ref must be declared in a previous block, or before the Ref in the same allOf. Every block must contain rubric and hint; hint must be a short hint that does not reveal the answer.
STRUCTURAL CONTRACT
A rubric must always be a JSON object with allOf and anyOf. allOf contains simultaneously mandatory requirements. anyOf contains complete groups of alternatives; use alternatives only when they are explicitly equivalent in the reference code.
Each requirement must use exactly one of these formats:
- ast_node: {"type":"ast_node","node":"While","bindNode":"sales_loop","afterRef":"first_read"}. node may only be If, While, For, FunctionDef, Return, Assign, AnnAssign, AugAssign, or Expr.
- comparison: {"type":"comparison","name":"!=","constant":0,"variableBind":"sale","ownerRef":"sales_loop"}. name may only be ==, !=, <, <=, >, or >=. Every comparison must include constant, variableBind or variableRef, and ownerRef; use exactly one of variableBind and variableRef.
- call: {"type":"call","name":"input","targetBind":"sale","bindOccurrence":"first_read"}
- assignment: {"type":"assignment","targetBind":"total","constant":0,"beforeRef":"sales_loop","outsideRef":"sales_loop"}
- accumulation: {"type":"accumulation","targetRef":"total","sourceRef":"sale","operator":"+=","form":"augmented","bindOccurrence":"sum_step","parentRef":"sales_loop"}. form may only be augmented or self_add; augmented uses operator += and self_add uses operator +.
- operator: {"type":"operator","name":"+=","insideRef":"sales_loop"}. name may only be ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, +, -, *, /, %, +=, -=, *=, /=, or %=.
- output_text: {"type":"output_text","value":"Total","afterRef":"sales_loop","outsideRef":"sales_loop"}
bindOccurrence and bindNode name a statement occurrence. beforeRef and afterRef preserve lexical order; insideRef requires a descendant, parentRef requires the direct structural parent, and outsideRef requires the occurrence to be outside the referenced structure.
Every Ref must point to a Bind declared in a previous block or an earlier requirement of the same allOf group, copying the Bind name literally. Never use future or invented references.
Mermaid IDs are never Bind or Ref names. Python variable names do not become Refs until they have literally appeared in a Bind field.
Use Bind for the first occurrence and Ref only for subsequent occurrences. When in doubt, use Bind again with the same name. Never send Bind and Ref for the same relationship in one requirement.
Optional beforeRef, afterRef, insideRef, parentRef and outsideRef fields must be null when there is no exact, necessary previous Bind. Do not invent a name to fill these fields.
Every If, While or For condition comparing a variable with a constant must first declare the ast_node with bindNode and immediately afterward the comparison with ownerRef pointing to that bindNode. A comparison can never appear alone or before its owner.
While, For and If are never equivalent. == and != are never equivalent. Variable names may change, but target, source, owner, occurrence, order and scope relationships must remain consistent through Bind and Ref.
For comparisons between a variable and a constant, name must be the operator normalized from the variable's point of view: 0 < x uses name >, while x < 0 uses name <.
Complete sales-loop rubric example:
{"allOf":[{"type":"ast_node","node":"While","bindNode":"sales_loop"},{"type":"comparison","name":"!=","constant":0,"variableBind":"sale","ownerRef":"sales_loop"}],"anyOf":[]}
For sales accumulation, declare exact forms as complete alternatives without future references: {"allOf":[{"type":"assignment","targetBind":"total","constant":0,"beforeRef":"sales_loop","outsideRef":"sales_loop"}],"anyOf":[{"allOf":[{"type":"accumulation","targetRef":"total","sourceRef":"sale","operator":"+=","form":"augmented","bindOccurrence":"sum_step","parentRef":"sales_loop"},{"type":"call","name":"input","targetRef":"sale","parentRef":"sales_loop","afterRef":"sum_step"}]},{"allOf":[{"type":"accumulation","targetRef":"total","sourceRef":"sale","operator":"+","form":"self_add","bindOccurrence":"sum_step","parentRef":"sales_loop"},{"type":"call","name":"input","targetRef":"sale","parentRef":"sales_loop","afterRef":"sum_step"}]}]}
A block must not use an isolated generic call, assignment, or comparison when the reference code provides structure, operands, scope, or relationships between variables.
Every Mermaid block other than Start or End must have at least one valid structural requirement in allOf or in an allOf group inside anyOf. Never return rubric as text, a bare list, acceptedEvidence, or an explanation.

{"referenceCode": "value = int(input())
print(value)", "mermaid": "flowchart TD
A(["Start"])
B[/"Read value"/]
C[/"Display value"/]
Z(["End"])
A --> B
B --> C
C --> Z", "blocks": [{"id": "B", "mermaidNodeId": "B", "label": "Read value", "kind": "input"}, {"id": "C", "mermaidNodeId": "C", "label": "Display value", "kind": "output"}], "invalidBlocks": [{"id": "B", "mermaidNodeId": "B", "label": "Read value", "kind": "input", "hint": "Read the value.", "rubric": {"allOf": [{"type": "call", "name": "input", "targetBind": "value"}], "anyOf": []}}, {"id": "C", "mermaidNodeId": "C", "label": "Display value", "kind": "output", "hint": "Display the value.", "rubric": {"allOf": [{"type": "call", "name": "print"}], "anyOf": []}}], "validationError": "<VALIDATION_ERROR>"}
